sections.heading: ARSON
sections.text: (1) Any person who sets fire or turns property into an explosive device without the owner's consent shall be guilty of arson. (2) Any person who sets fire, or explodes another person's property without consent with intent to cause injury or fatality to another player shall be guilty of arson. (3) This shall be a Class C offense. (4) Setting fire to a vehicle by shooting it shall not be subject to this article, so long as such use of force was justified, as prescribed by this Code and further legislation.

sections.heading: PETIT THEFT
sections.text: (1) Any person who physically takes property of another without the consent of the owner, shall be guilty of petit theft. (2) This shall be a Class G Offense.

sections.heading: DESTRUCTION OF PERSONAL PROPERTY
sections.text: (1) Any person who wilfully and maliciously damages, or otherwise destroys another's property shall be guilty of Destruction of personal property. Any person who wilfully destroys, causing harm or damages one's own property or another's, for the purposes of later committing criminal offenses with those modifications, shall be guilty of Destruction of personal property. (2) This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: DESTRUCTION OF GOVERNMENTAL PROPERTY
sections.text: (1) Any person who wilfully and maliciously damages, or destroys property that is owned by the government of the United States, the District of Columbia, or their ancillary agencies, shall be guilty of Destroying government property. (2) This shall be a Class C Offense.

sections.heading: VEHICULAR ASSAULT
sections.text: (1) Any person who intentionally, or through clear and extreme disregard for traffic law, utilizing a vehicle to strike a pedestrian, another vehicle, or someone else’s property, shall be guilty of Vehicular assault. (2) This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: GRAND THEFT AUTO
sections.text: (1) Any person who takes another's vehicle without the consent of the owner or enters another's vehicle without consent; however, if the driver is in the vehicle, they must instruct the subject to exit the vehicle otherwise they shall not be charged under this section; shall be guilty of Grand Theft Auto. (2) This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: LOITERING BY LEGISLATURES
sections.text: (1) Any person who remains within 100 studs of the Capitol Building or 50 studs of the City Hall, under circumstances that would warrant a reasonable person to believe that the purpose or effect of that behaviour is to enable a criminal street gang to establish control over identifiable areas, to intimidate others from entering those areas, or to conceal illegal activities shall be guilty of Loitering by legislature. (2) This shall be a Class D Offense.

sections.heading: – LOITERING BY FINANCIAL INSTITUTION
sections.text: (1) Any person who remains within 30 studs of any bank or financial institution, recognized under federal law or by the Department of Commerce and Labour, under circumstances that would warrant a reasonable person to believe that the purpose or effect of that behavior is to enable a criminal street gang to establish control over identifiable areas, to intimidate others from entering those areas, or to conceal illegal activities shall be guilty of Loitering by financial institution. (2) This shall be a Class F Offense.

sections.heading: UNLAWFUL TRESPASS
sections.text: (1) Any person who remains on the property of any person or organization, including the United States or the District of Columbia Government's property, without effective consent and the person either— (a) Had notice that the entry was forbidden; (b) Forced their way into the property; and/or (c) Received notice to depart but failed to do so; Shall be guilty of unlawful trespass. (2) This shall be a Class G Offense.
